prompt: Which plan follows the arrangement made for the woman’s sheet?
promptZh: 哪項做法符合兩人為這張紙安排的處理方式？

options.text: Leave it flat on its cloth; the staff will put it on the drying shelf.
options.zh: 先把紙平留在布上，由工作人員移到晾乾架。
options.whyZh: 紙還沾布，應平放留到明天；工作人員會移到晾乾架。

options.text: Peel it off now and leave it in a tray until tomorrow.
options.zh: 現在把紙剝下來，放托盤到明天。
options.whyZh: 現在先不剝；托盤留給今天能取紙的人。

options.text: Carry the cloth and sheet home on one of the empty trays.
options.zh: 用一個空托盤把布和紙一起帶回。
options.whyZh: 她會把紙留到明天，也不使用給當天取件者的托盤。

options.text: Leave the sheet on a tray and take the cloth home.
options.zh: 把紙留在托盤上，把布帶回家。
options.whyZh: 紙不能先離布；會安置在晾乾架，不是托盤。

explanationZh: 紙還沾布，應平放留到明天；工作人員會移到晾乾架。
evidence: Leave it flat on the cloth for now. The two empty trays by the door are for sheets that lift off without bending. / I have to go before the workshop closes. Can I leave it here until tomorrow? / Yes. Write your name on the little holder that grips the cloth. Do not write on the paper. We will set your sheet on a shelf so it can dry. The trays are for people taking their sheets home today.
